name: ferrow
description: Ferrow for Claude Code: /ferrow:connect, the Ferrow MCP server, the agent protocol skill, session hooks and a mod that wakes the session on new inbox work.

wake.title: Wake on new inbox work
wake.description: on: start a turn by itself; ask: ask first; off: never (the agent calls inbox_wait itself). /ferrow:wake overrides it on this machine.

watchman.title: Watchman after each Ferrow turn
watchman.description: on: after a turn that touched Ferrow, one fork of the conversation (billed to you) reviews the pack's unverified blocks and writes its flags and confirms to Ferrow (what Ferrow refuses waits behind f in the band); off: never. /ferrow:watchman overrides it on this machine.
